analyticalMisses.summary: Six games carried two REAL wagers each: $545.44 risked (25.6% of capital) returning -$164.88. That is more than twice the four-day net loss of -$77.45, so the rest of the book was net positive. The clearest case is 26SEP201510SEACOL, where COL 4+ and SEA 5+ were both bought on the same game: two positions expressing the same high-scoring thesis, and the game held both under, losing $104.99. 26SEP201610SFLAD lost $104.99 the same way across two families.

2026-09-18 put five of eight wagers into F5 inning_result on one slate: 1-4 for -$114.48, which is the whole of that day's -$94.18 and then some. Single-day, single-family loading turned one bad read of a market type into the worst day of the stretch. This is about same-day exposure shape, not about F5 being a bad family.

SEA 5+ was bought at 0.98 for $52.49 and lost the full stake. At that price the position risks 98 cents to win 2, so it needs roughly a 98% hit rate merely to break even before fees. Even when the game thesis is right, this is a market expression with almost no margin for error; a cheaper expression of the same lean (game total, or a lower team-total rung) would have carried the same view at a price that can absorb being wrong.

analyticalWins.summary: All 37 REAL wagers were captured automatically by the Kalshi router as authenticated execution receipts (importBatchId=kalshi-router-v1, entryMethod=IMPORTED_RECEIPT, economicsSource=EXACT_API_EXECUTION, feeStatus=ACTUAL_API_FILL), with 37 unique betIds and 37 unique sourceBetKeys. No screenshot handoff or manual reconstruction was needed, and no manual importer was invoked.
The five largest positions returned +$144.80 on $507.49 risked. The loss did not come from the biggest bets going wrong, so this stretch gives no evidence of a sizing failure on the top end.

KXMLBKS-26SEP201607MINLAA-LAARJOHNSON32-5 (NO on 5+ strikeouts) was graded LOSS. Ryan Johnson recorded 6 strikeouts in 4.2 innings (MLB Stats API gamePk 823975, playerId 696270, jersey 32 LAA, unique candidate, participation RESOLVED). An external note claiming 2 strikeouts was wrong; canonical settlement recovered the real line from the authoritative feed and was independently confirmed.

processErrors.summary: $35.76 in fees was paid on $2,127.86 risked (1.68%). Against a -$77.45 result that is 46% of the entire loss. At this staking cadence fee drag is not a rounding error and belongs in the pre-bet comparison between candidate expressions of the same thesis.

No CLV figure in this window may be used to judge model quality. The 100x price-unit defect was fixed prospectively (PR #230), but 57 of the 94 affected historical rows still take their 'closing' quote from the FIRST_DAILY checkpoint, which is not closing-line evidence. Historical CLV was deliberately NOT migrated in this mission and remains unsuitable for performance conclusions.

proposedInvestigations.summary: Add a pre-bet check on total exposure per gameKey across ALL families, not per market. Two wagers on one game that share a direction (SEA/COL both over, SF/LAD) are one position with two tickets. Measured cost this stretch: -$164.88 on 25.6% of capital.

Before placing, price the same game thesis as ML, F5, F7, game total, team total, and supported props, and record why the chosen expression won. This is the standing practice to continue; the 0.98 SEA 5+ entry is the concrete case where a cheaper expression of the same view existed.
Carry expected fee drag into that comparison explicitly. At 1.68% of risked capital it was 46% of this stretch's loss.
Flag when one market family takes more than roughly half of a single day's wagers (09-18: five of eight in F5). The aim is exposure shape, not avoiding any family.

Resolve the closing-quote selection defect (57 of 94 recent rows scored against a FIRST_DAILY quote) BEFORE any historical CLV migration. Until then CLV stays out of performance judgements. Tracked separately; explicitly out of scope here.

scope.note: REAL router receipts only. Legacy/model/paper tracked rows are excluded and are NOT part of any figure here. The 2026-09-17 ledger also carries 3 LEGACY_BACKFILL model rows (2378a0c45d, 8e7b4739cc, f4b9f2d663) which canonical settlement REFUSED rather than defaulted; they are not wagers.

statisticalCaution.summary: 37 wagers cannot establish or refute an edge for any market family. Team totals were 19/37 wagers and 53.9% of risked capital, finishing 10-9 for -$38.58 (-3.36% ROI). That is a CONCENTRATION finding and nothing more: it is not evidence that team totals are intrinsically bad. The same applies in both directions to every other family here, including winning_margin's +82% ROI on a single wager and pitcher_strikeouts' -13.5% on six. No family-level edge claim is made from this sample.
